entry_points.text: Default primary requests thread wakeup; nested primary and forced secondary warn and report unhandled as misconfiguration placeholders.
Matrix creation builds global and per-CPU state for width and window linking managed views, releasing partial allocation and returning null on failure.
Pending migration applies set when migratable preserving it when ineligible or busy with CPU-local misuse diagnosed; wrapper skips disabled, preserves masking, masked path needs descriptor lock.
MSI release, sysfs, mode, removal and debug manage lifecycle; domain deactivation, allocation, release and translation delegate to parent programming messages with unwinding.

exports.text: Notifier installs, replaces or clears per line atomically under spinlock with reference handling; eligibility, parent, presence and status queries exist, presence and status safe without descriptor lock.
Nonblocking disable returns promptly, hard disable waits when effective, NMI aliases delegate; wake nests touching hardware only on outermost transitions with failure restoring count.
Per-CPU request validates; enable, disable, liveness and free act per CPU refusing overlap; NMI enforces flag bans with prepare and teardown.
Thread woken by device identity with per-CPU rejection, readiness and secondary chaining protected; migration eligibility derives from top-level data.

Pool onlines and offlines aggregating shared free and reservation counts; system vectors marked with replacement; vectors allocate on best CPU, record explicitly, track demand, expose availability and debug protected; managed reserves, allocates and releases.
Descriptors insert, free over ranges and create singly with rollback under device mutex; message copies by reference or number; lookup handles PCI and generic; sysfs populates and destroys.

hazards.text: Misuse warns via external helpers: unbalanced wake, freeing free or enabled or non-NMI lines, freeing from interrupt context, active exit, missing wake and non-NMI prepare.
Oneshot waits while another CPU holds progress; affinity tolerates mask failure by skipping.
System marking traps on capacity excess, multi-map without replacement or missing prior; assignment and release warn once on range or booking errors.

invariants.text: Affinity adaptation snapshots protected affinity and applies it, restoring flag for retry when mask storage fails; one configuration is empty.

NMI only for directly managed NMI-capable chips without slow bus excluding parents with setup invalid and teardown no-op without hooks; per-CPU always per-CPU and suspend-insensitive, shared only when affinity excludes a CPU.
Search stays in window avoiding occupied sets; unmanaged prefers most free, managed least charge; empty masks invalid, missing resources yield no-space.

Setup guarantees initialized MSI state with stores, grouping, mutex and lifetime; affinity delegates to parent refreshing message; activation writes message; level needs flags else second slot stays clear.

locks.text: Spinlock guards oneshot, wake, NMI and unlinking without sleeping; bus lock serializes chip sequences; scoped lookup validates class.
MSI iteration needs device mutex with unlock parking iteration; teardown and lookup use scoped protection.

state_machines.text: Thread signals readiness, selects class, loops interruptibly with final run at stop, runs regular or forced path with chaining; oneshot clears bit and unmasks only when empty and enabled but masked.
Wake depth moves with hardware only on empty transitions; NMI sets after prepare and clears on cleanup or teardown, with per-CPU prepare before use and teardown after non-preemptibly.
Pool initializes once on first online then toggles online gating allocation.
MSI iteration starts at zero, scans forward from cache for filter match, yields null and parks at sentinel at end or on unlock.

structs.text: Per-CPU state has counters, init and online flags, paired general and managed bitmaps; global has width, window, availability, reservation, system bits, counts, per-CPU pointer and scratch with system half.
Descriptors carry lock, affinity, wake depth, oneshot, progress, thread mask, chain, per-CPU mask and queue; handlers carry number, callbacks, flags, names, identities, affinity and link.
MSI device has flags, mutex, per-domain stores and cache; range has domain, bounds and count; sysfs group msi_irqs starts empty; sentinel is max ulong minus one, capacity max index plus one.

Threaded handled count recorded; errors are invalid, no-memory, no-device and not-connected; flags include shared, per-CPU, no-thread, no-balance, no-suspend, no-autoenable, conditional-suspend, poll and sense.
